summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would retain the coronavirus supplement at $550 per fortnight for listed income support recipients and extend access to additional groups of pensioners.
It would extend eligibility to Disability Support Pension recipients and Age Pension recipients receiving Commonwealth Rent Assistance, with payments backdated to 25 September 2020.
The proposed payment period would run until 28 March 2021, with specified expanded payments also tied to continued payment of the supplement to JobSeeker recipients.
changes: The minister could not use the existing modification power to reduce or remove the supplement.
Separate powers to reduce or remove the Parenting Payment supplement during the initial period would be repealed.
The initial Youth Allowance supplement period would be extended to 28 March 2021.
summary.affected: Listed allowance and payment recipients, Disability Support Pension recipients and Age Pension recipients receiving rent assistance are affected.
